newsitem.title: ITALY: Naples to issue May CPI data on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Naples to issue May CPI data on Wednesday.

text.p: The Italian city of Naples will issue its May consumer price data at 1530 GMT on Wednesday after a technical hitch prevented publication of the figures on Tuesday, the city's press office said.
Naples is one of 11 Italian cities due to publish inflation data on Tuesday and Wednesday. The city's CPI weighs 6.64 percent on the national index.

Italian May CPI was seen at 1.5 percent year-on-year and 0.2 percent month-on-month, according to analysts' estimates after preliminary data from the cities of Genoa, Trieste, Bologna and Bari. April national inflation came in at 1.7 percent and 0.1 percent respectively.
Along with Naples publishing data on Wednesday are Palermo, Perugia, Venice, Florence, Milan and Turin.
A Naples town hall spokesman said that last week national statistics institute Istat had erroneously announced that Naples would be publishing its data on Tuesday instead of Wednesday.
